name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Inbound Account Executive | Short-Cycle SaaS Closing, Live Demos & Home Improvement Contractor Expertise
summary: SaaS closer with real numbers: up to 10 deals a month selling to small businesses at Fivestars, 120% of sales target at Wix, top three on a team of 8 to 15 at Accelo while quota roughly doubled (~$213K/year in services bookings), and ~$130K+ from 6 deals at Fetch & Funnel. Today I build AI-driven lead capture, follow-up, and appointment booking systems for home service contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), so I already speak the contractor's language and know exactly why a missed lead costs them a job.
